hero.name: Miguel David Tillero
hero.tagline: General Director of the projet indépendant of San Cristóbal de Las Casas. Specialist teacher in French as a Foreign Language (FFL), cultural management, and training. Experienced in Venezuela, Ecuador, Mexico, and France.

about.title: About Me
about.intro: I'm Miguel David Tillero Álvarez, a specialist teacher in French as a Foreign Language (FFL) with more than 15 years of experience in higher education and continuous training.
about.description: My multidisciplinary background combines pedagogy, applied linguistics, and cultural management. I have worked in educational institutions in Venezuela, Ecuador, Mexico, and France, developing innovative French language teaching and cultural management programs.
about.focus: My approach is centered on creating meaningful learning experiences, combining traditional methodologies with educational technology.

services.title: Services
services.training_desc: Specialized programs in French, cultural management, and trainer training.
services.consulting_desc: Advising on educational projects and cultural management.
services.teaching_desc: Individual and group French classes for all levels.
services.cultural_desc: Organization and direction of cultural events and Francophone activities.
